transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text: D.C. is a popular city for marathons! A marathon is a long race. Many marathons raise money for charity, you know - good works. A marathon is a good fitness goal too. I want to challenge myself in a marathon and maybe win a medal! Hey, there’s Ashley. Ashley! Wait for me! It’s Anna!

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text: Ash … ley. Ash … ley.

transcript.speaker: Ashley
transcript.text: Are you okay, Anna?

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text: I just ran … from over there.

transcript.speaker: Ashley
transcript.text: Do you want to sit down, Anna? Do you want some water? (Anna takes the bottle and tries to return it.) No thanks. You keep it.

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text: Thanks. I didn’t know you like to run.

transcript.speaker: Ashley
transcript.text: I love running. In fact, this weekend, I will run in my first marathon.

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text: Me … too.

transcript.speaker: Ashley
transcript.text: Really? You are running in a marathon?

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text: Yeah. In a couple of days. Why do you ask … like that?

transcript.speaker: Ashley
transcript.text: What do you know about running in a marathon?

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text: I know that there’s a lot of running and sometimes you can win a medal.

transcript.speaker: Ashley
transcript.text: How long have you been training?

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text: I started today. I’ve been training for an hour … no, an hour and seven minutes!

transcript.speaker: Ashley
transcript.text: Anna, training a little every day is a good habit to get into. Not all at once!

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text: Thanks for the advice, Ashley. But I’m running in a special race.

transcript.speaker: Ashley
transcript.text: What marathon is it?

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text: I don’t remember the name. But the website said everyone gets a medal.

transcript.speaker: Ashley
transcript.text: Okay, well, good luck, Anna!

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text: Thanks, Ashley. Good luck to you, too.

transcript.speaker: Ashley
transcript.text: Thank you.

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text: Bye!

transcript.speaker: Ashley
transcript.text: Bye, Anna!

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text: See you!
(At the race: an announcer calls out race information)

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text: Hello. I am here to enter the race!

transcript.speaker: Woman
transcript.text: But ma’am you can’t enter the race.

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text: What? How am I going to meet my goal?

transcript.speaker: Woman
transcript.text: Ma’am, this race is for children. You can’t run with the children.

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text: Children? Children. That’s perfect. I just might win!

transcript.speaker: Woman
transcript.text: No, ma’am. You really can’t run with the children.

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text: I’m sorry. Of course. I was only thinking of my goal.

transcript.speaker: Woman
transcript.text: Well, you can help us with our goal, which is to raise money for sick children. Would you like to help us?

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text: I’ve just found my new goal. And I get to wear a medal. (to child who finished race) Good job!

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text: Hello, it's Anna! I did it - Washington, D.C. is my home. Looking back over the past year, I’ve done so many amazing things! I have met people from all over the world. I’ve made many good friends. And I have a great job! And I've taken a lot of chances. And now I have some really big news! Wait for it… and 3, 2, 1…

transcript.speaker: Kelly
transcript.text: Hello and welcome to “Around the Corner and Across the Street from the Actor’s Studio!” Many people dream of becoming actors. But very often, those dreams don’t come true.

transcript.speaker: Kelly
transcript.text: Well, today we will meet a woman and -- her acting career has really taken off. In fact, she acted in my play, “The Woods Are Alive!” Oh. She really brought the part of Tree Number 15 to life! Let’s give a warm welcome to Anna Matteo!

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text: Thank you. Thank you so much for having me here.

transcript.speaker: Kelly
transcript.text: Please, please, sit down. Here, here, let me help you.

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text: Thanks. Thanks. Wow, it is great to see you again, Director Kelly!

transcript.speaker: Kelly
transcript.text: It’s great to see you too, Anna. I see you are still wearing your tree costume. Does this have anything to do with your big news?

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text: Yes. Yes, it does.

transcript.speaker: Kelly
transcript.text: Well, Anna, please share that news with us.

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text: Kelly, I will be acting in three movies.

transcript.speaker: Kelly
transcript.text: That is amazing! Anna, tell us more.

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text: Well, the first is a science fiction movie. The second is a romantic comedy. And the third is an action movie.

transcript.speaker: Kelly
transcript.text: That is so great! Let me guess -- you’re playing a tree in all of them!

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text: Yes! This is what happened. To prepare for your play, I had to find out what it was like to BE a tree in the world. I had to find out where to eat, where to shop, where to meet people and how to get around the city.

transcript.speaker: Kelly
transcript.text: Amazing. I think big things are going to happen for you, Anna. So, tell me, will you be moving to Hollywood for a career in movies?

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text: No. I’ll make the movies and then come back. Washington, D.C. is my home.

transcript.speaker: Kelly
transcript.text: I’m sure your family is very proud.

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text: Yes, they are. You know, Kelly, not too long ago, I didn’t feel very good about my life. I had to make a change. So, I took some chances. Sometimes I succeeded. Sometimes I failed. But I will never stop trying.

transcript.speaker: Kelly
transcript.text: Well, thank you for sharing your news and so much more with us, Anna.

transcript.speaker: Kelly
transcript.text: Until next time …
